mentions.name: Astrologer Cat
mentions.description: A toy astrology site built for fun, featuring an AI chat with Petunia the cat astrologer and a daily personalized astrology email. Planned features include ephemeris calculations and stories of historic events from past dates sharing today's astrological conditions.
mentions.audience: Everyone who loves astrology and cute cats
